source:
Hana: Moving the help button to the top right will confuse new users. People expect support in the footer, and this redesign will make tickets worse.
Ivo: It will reduce tickets. The current footer link is buried, and a top-right button is where people look when they need help.
Hana: You are assuming visibility equals comprehension.
Ivo: You are assuming the old convention still matters.

extraction.mainQuestion: Would moving the help button to the top right increase or reduce support tickets?

positions.label: Keep help in the footer
positions.thesis: The help button should stay in the footer because moving it to the top right will confuse new users.
positions.steelman: A familiar footer location may be easier for new users than a more visible but unexpected control.

groundingQuotes.quote: Moving the help button to the top right will confuse new users.

positions.label: Move help to top right
positions.thesis: The help button should move to the top right because the footer link is buried and a visible button will reduce tickets.
positions.steelman: Users who need help are more likely to notice a persistent top-right support button than a footer link.

claims.statement: Moving the help button to the top right will confuse new users and worsen tickets.

groundingQuotes.quote: this redesign will make tickets worse.

claims.statement: A top-right help button will reduce tickets because the footer link is buried.

groundingQuotes.quote: The current footer link is buried

disagreementCandidates.question: Would the top-right help button confuse users or reduce support tickets?
disagreementCandidates.summary: Both sides assert opposite effects of the redesign without offering evidence in the source.

participantStances.stance: It will confuse users and worsen tickets.
It will make help visible and reduce tickets.

disagreementCandidates.resolutionCondition: Run a usability test or ticket-rate comparison; the source itself provides no evidence.

caveats: The speakers make assertions but provide no evidence in the source.
